Bitmine Immersion Technologies, Inc. operates as a digital asset technology company in the United States. The company focuses on acquiring, holding and managing digital assets, as well as providing critical blockchain infrastructure services; and ethereum and bitcoin mining and hosting activities. It also provides blockchain infrastructure services; investments in early-stage blockchain opportunities; and ethereum-adjacent advisory services. In addition, the company offers blockchain validation and staking services; operational, maintenance and consulting services; and sells mining equipment. The company was formerly known as Sandy Springs Holdings Inc. Bitmine Immersion Technologies, Inc. was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut.
